Strength & Conditioning

Strong enough for real life

Alison’s been coaching strength and conditioning for almost 10 years. Her clients range from people who’ve never picked up a weight to amateur and pro boxers heading into fights.

Most of them though are everyday people who want to feel strong, move well and keep up with their life. She especially loves working with women who are done training just to be smaller. Walking into the weights area like you belong there, lifting things you didn’t think you could.. that confidence doesn’t stay in the gym.

  • 1-on-1 S&C built around your life and your goals
  • Women’s strength training programs.. strong, capable, confident
  • Athlete S&C for amateur and professional boxers
  • Face to face at Legacy Gym, Kincumber, or coached online
